exposure: Type of cesarean section (emergency vs. elective)
cohort: Patients who gave birth at Gynaecology unit-A of Lady Reading Hospital Peshawar between December 2010 and January 2011 (n=966)
finding: The rate of cesarean section was 21.7 per 100, with the majority being emergency cesarean sections, and the most common indications were fetal distress, obstructive labor/failure to progress, and previous cesarean section.
